description: This file defines the WorkerPoolImplementation class, which inherits from WPEFramework's Core::WorkerPool and ThreadPool::ICallback. It includes a nested Dispatcher class implementing ThreadPool::IDispatcher, and manages a worker thread pool with methods for initialization, cleanup, and idle state. The class is designed to be used as part of a larger system for managing worker threads.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: Implements a worker thread pool with a nested Dispatcher class for task dispatching, inheriting from WPEFramework core classes.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation::Dispatcher
classes.description: A nested class implementing ThreadPool::IDispatcher to handle job dispatching within the worker pool.
